name: Channels Without claude.ai OAuth
description: Enables the --channels feature regardless of claude.ai OAuth / account state by forcing the isChannelsEnabled() runtime feature gate (the server-side GrowthBook flag 'tengu_harbor', normally default-false and only delivered to OAuth'd claude.ai accounts) to default true. In 2.1.158 the explicit getClaudeAIOAuthTokens() auth check was removed from gateChannelServer; this tengu_harbor runtime gate is the sole remaining barrier, so flipping its default boolean from false (!1) to true (!0) lets channel servers register without claude.ai OAuth. Single-character, same-length edit inside the main CJS bun module.

provenance.author: genusdryasnizhninovgorod936
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref (upstream README failed to load; mapped via gateChannelServer/isChannelsEnabled semantics)

operations.rationale: isChannelsEnabled() (minified zEH) returns getFeatureValue_CACHED_MAY_BE_STALE('tengu_harbor', false). This runtime gate is checked before policy/session/allowlist and, in 2.1.158, is the only gate (the OAuth token check was removed) that depends on having a claude.ai account. Changing the default false (!1) to true (!0) enables channels without OAuth. 1-char same-length swap; \g<1> backref preserves the churn-prone minified function/helper identifiers (zEH, Z_).
